nodes.description: address private _config in UsingConfig storing the AddressConfig contract address
address private _storage in UsingStorage holding the EternalStorage contract address
address private _owner in Ownable holding the privileged owner account
address private currentOwner in EternalStorage, initialized to msg.sender, gating all state setters
MetricsGroup.addGroup(address _addr): validates caller is metricsFactory, writes group flag before external call, then updates total counts
MetricsGroup.removeGroup(address _addr): validates caller is metricsFactory, clears group flag before external call, then decrements total counts
MetricsGroup.isGroup(address _addr): reads the group boolean from EternalStorage
MetricsGroup.totalIssuedMetrics(): returns the stored total count of issued metrics
MetricsGroup.totalAuthenticatedProperties(): returns the stored count of authenticated properties
MetricsGroup.hasAssets(address _property): returns whether metrics count per property is greater than zero
MetricsGroup.getMetricsCountPerProperty(address _property): public view reading metrics count per property from EternalStorage
MetricsGroup.setMetricsCountPerProperty: internal write of metrics count per property into EternalStorage
MetricsGroup.setTotalIssuedMetrics: private write of total issued metrics into EternalStorage
MetricsGroup.setTotalAuthenticatedProperties: private write of authenticated properties count into EternalStorage
MetricsGroup.setTotalAuthenticatedPropertiesAdmin(uint256): owner-only deprecated administrative overwrite of the properties counter
UsingConfig.config(): internal view returning IAddressConfig(_config)
UsingStorage.eternalStorage(): internal view returning EternalStorage(_storage) guarded by hasStorage
UsingStorage.getStorageAddress(): external view exposing the storage address
UsingStorage.createStorage(): owner-only deployment of a new EternalStorage contract and assignment to _storage
UsingStorage.setStorage(address): owner-only assignment of the EternalStorage address
UsingStorage.changeOwner(address): owner-only delegation of ownership of the underlying EternalStorage contract
Ownable.owner(): returns the current owner
Ownable.isOwner(): compares _msgSender() with _owner
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner, sets _owner to address(0)
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner, forwards to _transferOwnership
Ownable._transferOwnership(address): internal state write of _owner with zero-address check
EternalStorage.changeOwner(address): external owner transfer guarded by msg.sender == currentOwner
EternalStorage.setUint(bytes32,uint256): onlyCurrentOwner write into uIntStorage mapping
EternalStorage.setBool(bytes32,bool): onlyCurrentOwner write into boolStorage mapping
EternalStorage.getBool(bytes32): view read from boolStorage mapping
EternalStorage.getUint(bytes32): view read from uIntStorage mapping
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256): checked addition with overflow require
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256): checked subtraction with underflow require
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256): checked multiplication with overflow require
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256): checked division rejecting zero divisor

removeGroup clears the group flag and then makes the untrusted IMetrics(_addr).property() external call before decrementing counters
UsingStorage.changeOwner forwards execution to the external EternalStorage.changeOwner entry point after onlyOwner validation
